newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's ICO signs 60 bln peseta syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Spain's ICO signs 60 bln peseta syndicated loan.

text.p: Spain's Official Credit Institute (ICO) said on Wednesday it had arranged a four year syndicated loan with a group of banks for a total of 60 billion pesetas, convertible into bonds.
The lending banks each have the option to convert their share of the loan into medium and long-term bonds issued by ICO, Spain's financial credit body, on December 31, 1997.
The syndicate includes 13 financial institutions, including one bank and 12 regional savings banks.
